input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives the Company a no-cause exit on 90 days' notice within an annual term, which sits at the fallback (60–90 days), and HDI's mirror right is also at 90 days rather than the sub-90-day notice that would be walk-away; Section 1.6 adds a penalty-free exit if the Site is not live in 70 days. The uncapped Termination Payment in Section 4.2 is the real problem and is redlined once, under LD, rather than flagged twice; our RENEWAL redline also shortens our own notice to 30 days while leaving HDI at 90.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews annually with a 90-day non-renewal notice window, which exceeds the fallback of no more than 60 days. The 12-month renewal length is acceptable and there is no renewal price uplift (fees are a revenue share), so no uplift cap is needed. We shortened the Company's window to 30 days while leaving HDI at 90 days so HDI cannot exit on shorter notice; absence of a renewal reminder is noted but not flagged.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred governing law and there is no arbitration clause or foreign venue. The clause is silent on forum (no express submission to the New York courts), which we note as a minor gap rather than a deviation.
